snippet.title: PlayStation - Punky Skunk (1998)
snippet.description:
DESCRIPTION
Punky ain't your typical mascot "with an attitude." He's a gen-X skunk who loves extreme sports and he's on a mission! He's gotta save his friends, rescue his forest home and stop a mad wolf's diabolical plot to rule the world! Over 30 huge levels with multiple pathways and bonus levels!
